milestones.title: 0.75.0 — reliability & enforcement
milestones.summary: The owner's four verbatim asks shipped together: the transient-API retry ladder (immediate → 1.5m → 5m → 10m → 30m → stop+notify, visible status card), hard task-mode enforcement (plan/review/explore read-only at the toolset level, owner-pinned, debug command tier, delegation inheritance), hover-only mode descriptions + read-only badges, and the single-row composer toolbar with the actually-working 5-line textarea. The deepest find: SDK error PARTS were swallowed — real 429s could never classify nor ladder; the adapter now re-throws them (live-verified).

current.title: R75 — the reliability & enforcement round
current.detail: The owner's four verbatim asks, all browser-verified: (1) the TRANSIENT-API RETRY LADDER (lib/retry.ts NEW) — rate_limit/network/timeout failures retry immediately then wait 1.5/5/10/30 min (six attempts total) before stopping + notifying + showing the error; auth/overflow/unknown never auto-retry; the amber RetryStatusCard (attempt N/6, class chip, live countdown) shows during waits and clears on the first content frame; the terminal card + task_failed notification carry attempts. (2) TASK MODES ARE NOW HARD-ENFORCED (agents/mode-policy.ts NEW) — plan/review/explore intersect the turn's toolset to read-only (write_file/edit_file/create_dir/delete_file/run_command/index_project/job_stop REMOVED; the prompt's toolNames match — the model never sees a tool it cannot call), debug demotes run_command to the auto tier in approvals (ask-tier denied even under Full Access), children inherit the parent's mode at delegation, and read-only modes are OWNER-PINNED (switch_mode cannot leave them — live-verified: a plan-mode session asked to write a file honestly reported its read-only toolset, no file written). (3) Mode menus are single-line — descriptions ride the rows' title tooltips (hover to reveal) + accent read-only badges. (4) The composer toolbar is ONE row in the owner's exact order (attach, access, mode, context, model, reasoning, send) — the box is a CSS @container, pills collapse to icons below 560px; the textarea ACTUALLY auto-grows now (flex-1 was silently ignoring the height style — the never-worked 'two lines' bug, proven live: style.height=132px while clientHeight=34px): 5 visible lines then internal scroll, driven by a useLayoutEffect keyed on input (programmatic fills resize too). THE ROUND'S DEEPEST FIND: the AI SDK delivers post-retry provider errors as fullStream error PARTS the stream adapter ignored — real 429s classified 'unknown', could never ladder, and showed no honest class; chat.ts now re-throws them (live-verified against a mock 429 provider: meta.retry frames on the wire, attempt 2 immediate → attempt 3 at 90s with heartbeat ticks). Also fixed: the sync-path ok:true sub-agent lie (failed-after-partial turns now return honest 502 + recorded usage), the boot sweep's silent death (crash mid-turn now writes the INTERRUPTED turn.error + keeps the session retryable), errorClass+attempts ride to the UI, meta.overflow_recovery finally renders. 2 NEW suites: r75-retry-ladder (19) + r75-mode-policy (27) incl. pinning. 2613 root tests (2558+55) green; lint + typechecks + docs:check 172/0/0 clean.
